title: Nottinghamshire MvF rich Web Push payload
description: Producer contract for the encrypted JSON body. All fields are optional. The worker also tolerates historical plain text, empty bodies and unknown fields. Send portable root-relative paths to work on installed clients and preview origins.

canReply.description: Metadata from the Training dispatcher. Training notifications open the session.

action.description: Reserved fixture actions: lineup, availability, in, maybe, out. Other IDs open the notification destination.

path.description: A root-relative path that still resolves within the app, including its optional query and fragment.
